checks: two agents enrolled with individual server-bound keys
targeted stage reaches only selected agent; baseline stays active for others
built Claude hook enforces targeted policy and reports its loaded revision
policy loading receipt requires exact revision hash and assigned version
fleet view distinguishes reported current policy from missing receipt
bound key cannot impersonate another agent or change its binding
unknown or foreign rollout targets refused atomically
rollback republishes baseline as a newer version and clears targeted assignments
reviewed staged version can be promoted to all agents
stale operator restore conflicts instead of overwriting newer publication
immutable revision history retains baseline and staged policy
scope: Isolated HTTP/database integration; receipts are agent-reported, not platform attestation.
